edits.text: 3. COMPENSATION. During the Term, the Executive shall receive the following compensation and benefits: (a) an annual base salary, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable payroll deductions and withholdings; (b) an annual target bonus opportunity, with the actual amount, if any, determined in accordance with the Company’s bonus criteria and performance objectives established by the Company from time to time; and (c) participation in employee benefit plans and programs generally made available to similarly situated senior executives of the Company, in each case subject to the terms and conditions of such plans and programs as in effect from time to time.
edits.name: compensation_body_text

edits.text: 4. SEVERANCE. If the Executive’s employment is terminated by the Company without Cause or by the Executive for Good Reason, then, subject to the Executive’s timely execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims, the Executive shall be entitled to the severance benefits set forth herein. The severance benefits shall consist of the Severance Amount, payable in accordance with the timing and manner set forth in this Agreement. No other post-employment obligation shall be a condition precedent to receipt of the severance benefits, except that the Executive shall remain bound by the Executive’s continuing obligations regarding confidentiality, non-solicitation, and other obligations expressly intended to survive termination.
edits.name: severance_release_only

edits.text: 5. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. During the twelve (12) months following termination of the Executive’s employment, the Executive shall not, to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, directly or indirectly: (a) solicit for employment any employee of the Company with whom the Executive had material contact during the twelve (12) months preceding termination; (b) solicit or attempt to solicit the business of any customer or prospective customer of the Company with whom the Executive had material contact during the twelve (12) months preceding termination, in each case using confidential information or trade secrets of the Company; or (c) use or disclose the Company’s confidential information or trade secrets other than as required in the performance of the Executive’s duties or as otherwise permitted by law. Any broader non-compete shall apply only to the extent enforceable under applicable law and shall be construed narrowly so that the non-solicitation and confidentiality restrictions are the primary post-termination protections.
edits.name: restrictive_covenant_narrowed
